description: The Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia, in Formal Case No. 1102, by Order No. 22896, dated July 2, 2026, closed this proceeding. The purpose of this matter was to investigate issues relating to the use of Verizon Washington, DC Inc.’s (“Verizon DC”) copper infrastructure for the provision of telecommunications services. By the end of 2023, Verizon DC replaced all copper distribution and loop facilities with fiber-to-the-premises facilities at all locations in the District of Columbia. Thus, this proceeding can be closed.

1. 
By this Order, the Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia 
(“Commission”) closes Formal Case No. 1102.1 The purpose of this matter was to investigate 
issues relating to the use of Verizon Washington, DC Inc.’s (“Verizon DC” or “Company”) 
copper infrastructure for the provision of telecommunications services. By the end of 2023, 
Verizon DC has replaced all copper distribution and loop facilities with fiber-to-the-premises 
facilities at all locations in the District of Columbia (“District”). Thus, this proceeding can be 
closed. 

2. 
On January 17, 2013, the Commission opened a proceeding to investigate issues 
related to Verizon DC's continued use of its copper infrastructure for the provision of 
telecommunications services and the Company’s plan for transitioning customers from the 
telecommunications services provided over copper facilities to telecommunications services 
provided over fiber facilities.2 

3. 
On December 1, 2020,3 January 11, 2021,4 and July 8, 2022,5 Verizon DC filed 
Notices regarding the replacement of copper facilities by fiber-to-the-premises facilities for the

retired all of their copper facilities, Verizon DC would: (1) no longer offer new services over 
copper facilities; and (2) cease maintaining these particular copper facilities.6 
4.
With the retirement of all Verizon DC’s copper facilities, the Commission notifies
all parties of its intent to close Formal Case No. 1102. If any interested person objects to closing 
this case because there are unresolved issues, then that person has ten (10) days from the date of 
this Order to file an objection identifying those issues. If no objection is filed within 10 days, 
then this case shall be closed without further action by the Commission.7 
THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED THAT: 
5.
Formal Case No. 1102 shall be CLOSED ten (10) days from the date of this
Order.
